dead_ends.approach: doctrine_verify running 'ruff check tools tests' + 'unittest discover -s tests' unconditionally
dead_ends.why_failed: in a consumer repo tools/ and tests/ also hold the host's code; it linted foreign files and ran the host suite + doctrine's 9-min self-tests. Scope by is_source_repo()

dead_ends.approach: counting bare verdict tokens (VETO/FAIL/PASS) across artifact diffs

learned.claim: v0.6.13 (ADR-002): doctrine_verify is now scope-aware. is_source_repo() (true only when pyproject declares 'doctrineos', which the installer never copies) runs the full dev suite in source; a consumer verifies only lint + state, skipping ruff/tests on the host's own code.
learned.evidence: tools/doctrine_verify.py; docs/adr/002-consumer-verify-scope.md; real consumer proof VERIFY OK
